meta.name: hyperframes-audio
meta.description: Use when audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition needs to be mixed: fade-in/fade-out, crossfade, track gain or volume, volume automation, ducking, a music bed that fights a voiceover (voiceover carve), effects on a track (EQ, compressor, limiter, gate, saturation, delay, reverb, chorus, phaser, bitcrush), automation envelopes drawn on a track's volume or any effect parameter, or one submix bus carrying a chain, a fader and an automation clock for several tracks at once (`<hf-audio-group>`). Don't use for sourcing or generating audio — finding BGM, SFX, or making a voiceover is `/media-use`. Don't use for clip timing or track layout, which is `/hyperframes-core`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把视频里的配乐与旁白混合好,做淡入淡出、音量自动压低与音效处理
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果视频里的背景音乐盖住了人声,想快速把两条音轨混好。
copy.tagline_en: Mix music and voiceover in your video with fades, ducking, and track effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if background music drowns out the voiceover and you need them balanced.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会对已经放进 HyperFrames 合成里的音频做混音：淡入淡出、交叉淡化、轨道增益与音量自动化、ducking、人声 carve、效果链，以及用 <hf-audio-group> 搭的总线。
howto.when: 当已放入合成的音频需要混音时接管，比如淡入淡出、轨道音量或自动化、音乐床压过配音。音频获取与生成归 /media-use，片段时序与轨道布局归 /hyperframes-core。

say.text: 把这段配音下面的音乐做人声 carve，音乐保留低音和高音
say.note: 会在音乐轨写入 carve 属性并压低冲突频段

say.text: 给这条音轨加淡入淡出，人声再加 80 Hz 高通
say.note: 写入淡入淡出包络和 EQ 链

say.text: 把几个旁白片段归到一个组，再用这个组去 carve 音乐
say.note: 之后加入该组的片段也会被覆盖

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude mixes audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition: fades, crossfades, track gain, volume automation, ducking, voiceover carve, effect chains, and a submix bus via <hf-audio-group>.
howto.when_en: Triggers when placed audio needs mixing: fades, track volume or automation, or a bed fighting a voiceover. Sourcing audio is /media-use; clip timing and layout are /hyperframes-core.

say_en.text: Carve the voiceover out of the music bed, keeping the bed's lows and highs.
say_en.note: Writes carve attributes onto the bed track

say_en.text: Add a fade-in/fade-out to this track and a highpass at 80 Hz on the voice.
say_en.note: Writes fade envelopes and the EQ chain

say_en.text: Group the narration clips, then carve the bed against that group.
say_en.note: Later clips added to the group are covered too
